subject: Staggered team adoption playbook & quota reconciliation
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@fractalhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Staggered team adoption playbook & quota reconciliation

Hi Sara —

Great to hear FractalHealth is looking to roll Redwood out to two additional product teams (Clinical QA + Patient Outreach). I put together a short playbook for a staggered adoption so you can ramp without a big upfront uplift on committed capacity. Attaching the estimate and the proposed key naming / scoping conventions.

High-level suggestion:
- Week 1-3: Clinical QA (pilot): 3 API keys, 2 reserved slots, conservative burst headroom.
- Week 4-8: Patient Outreach (pilot): add 2 API keys, enable KV prefix caching on the outreach routes.
- Week 9+: Promote both apps to production with a shared dedicated pool + per-project quotas.

Action items I recommend:
1) Procurement review pricing addendum (attached).
2) Your infra lead confirm domain/IP ranges for VPC peering (if you want Private).
3) We schedule a 45 min runbook walk-through with your engineering leads next week.

Attachment summary: FRCT-Expansion-Estimate-v2.pdf (pricing estimate / monthly committed capacity)
Staggered-rollout-playbook.xlsx (key naming, firewall CIDR, canary steps)

Would Thursday 10/7 at 10am PT work for the runbook?

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: FRCT-Expansion-Estimate-v2.pdf (pricing table)]
[Attachment: staggered-rollout-playbook.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@fractalhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fractalhealth.com
Date: 2026-10-03T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered team adoption playbook & quota reconciliation

Alex —

Thanks for the clear plan, this is exactly what we needed to see. The timelines look reasonable. A couple quick notes from our side:
- Clinical QA wants to run longer (6 weeks) on pilot; they have more evaluation checkpoints.
- Patient Outreach will need higher burst capacity during campaign windows (we’ll mark those in the playbook).

I’ve looped procurement — they need the line-item pricing and a draft amendment for signature authority. Can your team produce a concise amendment (1–2 pages) that we can give our legal/procurement? Also confirm whether the reserved slots are changeable mid-term.

Thursday 10/7 10am PT works for the runbook call.

Sara Lim
Director, Product Operations — FractalHealth
Sara.Lim@fractalhealth.com

[Inline: Please put procurement on future price questions]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered team adoption playbook & quota reconciliation

Alex / Marissa —

I reviewed the estimate and sketched a 1-page amendment that calls out: committed monthly tokens, per-key rate for overages, upfront discount tier for multi-team add-on, and a 30-day rollback window for reserved slots if usage < 60% for 2 consecutive months.

Two questions for contract/legal:
1) Do we want to offer a short-term uplift pilot rate for Clinical QA for the extra 3 weeks they requested? I can propose a 10% pilot uplift instead of full commit.
2) Should we include a clause for automatic per-key quota scaling during scheduled campaign windows (so Fractal doesn’t hit throttles)?

I attached the draft amendment and a redline checklist. If you want, I’ll push the amendment to the HubSpot deal record after we finalize.

[Attachment: FRCT-Amendment-Draft-1p.docx (amendment draft)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered team adoption playbook & quota reconciliation

Thanks Ben — draft looks good. A few edits:
- Replace “30-day rollback” language with a clearer usage review cadence: monthly check + one-time adjustment request within 45 days.
- Add explicit language that dedicated capacity changes require 14 days notice for provisioning.
- For pilot uplift, I prefer a limited pilot price (flat pilot fee) rather than a percent uplift — simplifies procurement.

Laura — can you confirm if ops can provision per-key quota autoscaling for scheduled campaign windows? If yes, we should include the tech detail in the amendment (call out the autoscale API and throttling safety cap).

I’ll incorporate and send the 1-page amendment to Alex to share with Sara/procurement.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

[Attachment: FRCT-Amendment-Draft-1p.docx (redlined by Marissa)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@fractalhealth.com>, procurement@fractalhealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered team adoption playbook & quota reconciliation

Sara / Procurement —

Attaching the updated 1-page amendment per Marissa’s edits + a short tech appendix that confirms autoscale behavior and the 14-day provisioning window. Key points:
- Committed monthly tokens: 1.2M (shared pool) with per-key soft quotas.
- Pilot fee: $6,000 flat for the extra 3-week Clinical QA extension (covers burst capacity + monitoring).
- Autoscale: available via quota API; safety cap set at 2x baseline per key during scheduled campaign windows; provisioning lead time 14 days.

Next steps:
1) Procurement review/confirm signatory and we’ll push DocuSign link.
2) Engineering runbook call: Thu 10/7 10am PT (I’ll send the calendar invite).
3) Post-signature: we’ll provision keys and schedule a 30-minute check at Week 3 of the Clinical QA pilot.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/FRCT-4921
Doc sign (draft): https://redwood.app/sign/FRCT-4921-amendment

Thanks —
Alex
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com

[Attachment: FRCT-Amendment-1p-final.pdf (amendment for signature)]
